name: restaurant-management-system
description: Restaurant Management System - A full-stack restaurant ordering and kitchen display system

scripts.db:migrate: cd database && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.db:push: cd database && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "npm run customer:dev" "npm run admin:dev" "npm run chief:dev"
scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:setup
scripts.build:dev: cd apps/admin-web && npm run build && cd ../.. && rm -rf dist && cp -r apps/admin-web/dist dist
